statements.t: “We are executing with discipline as we complete the final steps toward our planned BLA submission for TA-ERT in December, which we believe will be a defining milestone for Spruce and for the children and families living with MPS IIIB,” said Javier Szwarcberg, M.D., M.P.H., Chief Executive Officer of Spruce Biosciences.

“Our pre-BLA meetings with the FDA in the second quarter provided alignment on the content and format of the BLA, and we remain on track to complete our second Process Performance Qualification (“PPQ”) batch and initiate our TrAnsform confirmatory study as planned in December.”
